chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to me; Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to me from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Bashshar from Abdullah al-Dihqan from Durust from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever recites 'Alhakum al-takathur' before sleeping will be protected from the trial of the grave.

key_terms.أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ: Al-Takathur (The Rivalry in Worldly Increase), referring to Surah 102 of the Quran.
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of God (Prophet Muhammad SAWW).
key_terms.عِنْدَ النَّوْمِ: Before sleeping / at the time of sleep.

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of reciting Surah Al-Takathur before sleeping?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a specific spiritual remedy for the anxieties of the intermediate realm (Barzakh) by linking the recitation of Surah Al-Takathur to protection from the grave's trial. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on the transformative power of Quranic recitation at key moments, such as sleep, to safeguard the soul from the distractions of worldly accumulation that characterize the fitnah of the grave.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq  (a.s.)  said,  “One  who  recites  Surah Takathur before going to bed would remain safe from the chastisement of grave.”
